blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Language model performance depends strongly on the mixture of domains in the pretraining data corpus. Popular data mixing methods select these domain weights by training many small proxy models on random mixes and then fitting a regression model to predict performance from the mix. We recognize this practice as a domain attribution problem, where the regression measures each domain's contribution to the target metric. Through this lens, the standard Dirichlet sampling of proxy data mixes is a poor regression design that requires tuning and cannot support a linear fit for hundreds of domains. Building on classical optimal experimental design, we introduce LinMix, which samples mixes at the vertices of the capped simplex so that each domain is at its cap or absent. This hyperparameter-free vertex sampling decorrelates domain effects, enabling an interpretable linear model whose coefficients are the domain attributions. The optimal mix given by LinMix provably keeps only domains with positive attribution values and requires no search over candidate mixes. We further establish the optimality of vertex sampling, and prove that Dirichlet sampling inflates the attribution error when its mixes concentrate around the prior data mix. Pretraining experiments with 1B-parameter OLMo2 and 4B Qwen3.5 language models show that LinMix outperforms Dirichlet-based data mixing across reasoning, code, and math benchmarks, with relative gains of 46% on MBPP and 14% on GSM8K. At 288 fine-grained domains, only vertex sampling supports a linear fit, and LinMix improves benchmark accuracy by 11% on average over the best nonlinear baseline.
blocks.zh: 语言模型的性能强烈地依赖于预训数据库中域的混合. 受欢迎的数据混合方法通过在随机混合上训练出许多小的代用模型来选择这些域分量,然后安装一个回归模型来从混合中预测性能. 我们认识到这种做法是一个域归属问题,即回归度量每个域对目标指标的贡献。 通过这个镜头,代用数据组合的标准Drichlet采样是一个差的回归设计,需要调制,不能支持适合上百个域的线性. 在古典最佳实验设计的基础上,我们引入了LinMix,在被封顶的"简易"的顶点上取出样品相混合,使每个域都处于顶点或缺席. 这种超参数无顶点采样会给域效应带来装饰,使得一个可解释的线性模型能够以域归属为系数. LinMix给出的最佳组合可以证明只保留了带有正属性值的域,不需要对候选组合进行搜索. 我们进一步确定顶点采样的最佳性,并证明Drichlet采样在将归属误差集中到先前的数据组合上时会夸大. 使用1B参数OLMo2和4B Quen3.5语言模型的预训实验显示,LinMix超越了基于Drichlet的数据在推理,代码和数学基准上相混合,MBPP的相对收益为46%,GSM8K的相对收益为14%. 在288个细纹域中,只有顶点采样支持线性吻合,而LinMix比最佳非线性基线平均提高了11%的基准精度.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
The composition of a pretraining dataset, drawn from an ever-growing data corpus, is one of the most decisive factors governing the downstream capabilities of large foundation models ( Gadre et al., 2023 ; Team Olmo, 2025 ) .
Given the impressive gains in model training efficiency and benchmark performance obtained by curating an optimal dataset, data mixing has emerged as a well-founded optimization problem.
Naturally, a source dataset can be split into the so-called domain subsets based on their web origin ( Fan et al., 2024 , e.g., GitHub, arXiv,) , semantic type ( Li et al., 2024 , e.g., code, math,) , or statistical profile ( Diao et al., 2025 , e.g., by clustering data representations,) .
Data mixing is then commonly formulated as a domain-weighting problem, where each domain receives a fraction of the target model’s token budget and the model is pretrained on the resulting mixture ( Xie et al., 2023 ; Li et al., 2024 ; Thudi et al., 2025 ; Xie et al., 2025 ; Tan et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh:
从不断增长的数据库中提取的预训数据集构成,是决定大型基础模型下游能力的最决定性因素之一(Gadre等人,2023年;Team Olmo,2025年)。
鉴于在模型培训效率和基准业绩方面取得令人印象深刻的进展,通过整理最佳数据集,数据混合已成为一个有充分依据的优化问题。
自然,一个源数据集可以根据其网络来源(Fan等人,2024年,如GitHub,arXiv,),语义类型(Li等人,2024年,如代码,数学),或统计概况(Diao等人,2025年,如通过分组数据表达),分为所谓的域子集.
数据混合随后通常被表述为域加权问题,每个域都得到目标模型的象征性预算的一小部分,该模型在生成的混合物上受到预先训练(Xie等人,2023年;Li等人,2024年;Thudi等人,2025年;Xie等人,2025年;Tan等人,2026年).

blocks.en:
In this work, we study regression -based data mixing ( Liu et al., 2025 ; Wettig et al., 2025 ; Ye et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2026 ) , which consists of two stages:
(i) training a swarm of small proxy models on randomly sampled mixes, and
(ii) selecting the target mix by optimizing a regression model fit to predict performance from the mix.
This procedure improves both the benchmark performance and the training efficiency of language models, yet two of its design choices remain poorly understood and are addressed ad hoc in practice.
First, it is unclear from which distribution the proxy mixes should be drawn, a question we frame as the classic problem of regression design ( Kiefer and Wolfowitz, 1959 ) , where the sampled mixes govern how much a fixed budget of proxy runs reveals about each domain’s effect.
Second, we show that popular methods do not scale to hundreds of fine-grained domains, where their Dirichlet sampling and optimization hyperparameters lack working defaults and require per-setup heuristic tuning, which becomes increasingly difficult as the number of domains increases.
blocks.zh:
在这项工作中,我们研究基于回归的数据混合(Liu等人,2025年;Wettig等人,2025年;Ye等人,2025年;Chen等人,2026年),包括两个阶段:
(一) 在随机抽取的混合物上培训一批小型代用模型,
(二)通过优化适合从组合中预测性能的回归模型来选择目标组合.
这一程序提高了语文模式的基准业绩和培训效率,但其中两项设计选择仍然没有得到很好的理解,在实践中是临时解决的。
首先,目前还不清楚应该从哪一种分配中提取代理组合,我们把这个问题作为回归设计(Kiefer和Wolfowitz,1959年)的经典问题来描述代理组合的固定预算如何揭示每个域的效果。
第二,我们显示,流行的方法不会扩展到数百个精细的分泌域,在这些域中,它们的Dirichlet采样和优化超参数缺乏工作默认值,需要每个设置的heuristic调制,随着域数的增加,这种调制变得越来越困难.

blocks.en:
Domain attribution. In parallel, data attribution quantifies how much a model’s behavior depends on its training data ( Koh and Liang, 2017 ; Ghorbani and Zou, 2019 ) .
We formalize regression-based data mixing as a form of data attribution, in which domains replace individual training samples.
A linear fit to the proxy runs thus yields a domain-level datamodel ( Ilyas et al., 2022 ) , whose coefficients measure each domain’s marginal contribution to the target outcome.
Consequently, a reliable regression design identifies these interpretable domain weights, an objective this work addresses from first principles.
blocks.zh:
域归属. 同时,数据归属可以量化一个模型的行为在多大程度上取决于其训练数据(Koh and Liang, 2017;Ghorbani and Zou, 2019).
我们正式将基于回归的数据混合作为数据归属的一种形式,其中域取代单个培训样本.
因此,一个适合代理运行的线性生成一个域级数据模型(Ilyas等人,2022年),其系数衡量每个域对目标结果的边际贡献.
因此,可靠的回归设计确定了这些可解释域权重,这是这项工作从第一原则着手的目标。

blocks.en:
Contributions. We introduce LinMix as a simple and effective data mixing method whose vertex proxy sampling scheme enables selection of the optimal mix for language model pretraining via an interpretable linear model (§ 3 ).
Figure 1 illustrates its design.
Pretraining experiments with 1B-parameter OLMo2 and 4B Qwen3.5 language models demonstrate that LinMix outperforms data mixing methods relying on Dirichlet sampling across reasoning, code, and math benchmarks (§ 4 ).
Furthermore, our theoretical analysis reveals fundamental limitations of Dirichlet-based mixing (§ 5 ).
Beyond requiring heuristic hyperparameter tuning, it severely inflates attribution error whenever proxy mixes concentrate around the prior or when the prior becomes skewed (Theorem 1 ).
Finally, we formally establish the theoretical optimality of vertex sampling in LinMix (Theorem 2 ).

blocks.en: 3 Data Mixing as Linear Domain Attribution
blocks.zh: 3 数据混合为线性域分配

blocks.en:
We formalize data mixing as a domain attribution problem seeking an interpretable linear model whose coefficients measure each domain’s contribution to the target outcome.
We empirically find that such a linear fit cannot be supported using Dirichlet-sampled proxy runs, and prior work compensates by using nonlinear surrogates and per-setup hyperparameter tuning, which we report in Section 4 .
Instead of changing the surrogate model, we change the design by sampling 𝚷 \boldsymbol{\Pi} to maximize the information the proxy runs carry about the domain effects, after which nonlinear models offer no better fit than the linear one.
Reliable attribution in turn enables the constrained optimization of 𝝅 target \boldsymbol{\pi}_{\text{target}} , where Dirichlet-based methods degrade once d d reaches hundreds of fine-grained domains.
blocks.zh:

4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en:
Data. We use the 200B-token WebOrganizer corpus ( Wettig et al., 2025 ) built from CommonCrawl web data and cleaned for language model pretraining.
Each document is assigned one of 24 topics (e.g., science, politics) and one of 24 formats (e.g., academic writing, news), and we split the corpus into 2048-token sequences, each drawn from a single domain.
We study two mixing granularities: 24 coarse domains given by the topics alone, and 288 fine-grained domains formed by the larger half of the 24 × 24 24\times 24 topic–format pairs, covering 94% of the corpus (cf. App. Figure 5 ).
Removing the practically empty tail from the prior data mix reduces noise when estimating domain weights.

blocks.en:
Language models. Following Chen et al. (2026) , we build on the open source OLMo 2 implementation ( Team OLMo et al., 2025 ) to train 30M and 60M proxy models and 1B target models.
All models are trained past the 20 20 tokens-per-parameter Chinchilla ratio ( Hoffmann et al., 2022 ) to avoid undertraining ( Chen et al., 2025b ) , on 1B, 2B, and 32B tokens, respectively.
This setup is comparable to prior work that pairs 27M ( Liu et al., 2025 ) and 50M ( Wettig et al., 2025 ) proxies with 1B targets.
Following Wettig et al. (2025) , we set the up-sampling cap to κ ≈ n / b target \kappa\approx n/b_{\text{target}} so that no sequence repeats at the target scale, a non-arbitrary choice shared by all sampling methods we compare.
Hyperparameters and further training details are given in Appendix C .

blocks.en:
Target benchmarks. We optimize data mixes for three targets: ARC ( Clark et al., 2018 , easy and challenge,) for scientific question answering; HellaSwag ( Zellers et al., 2019 ) for commonsense reasoning; and HellaSwag combined with PIQA ( Bisk et al., 2020 ) as a two-benchmark target.
In each case, we optimize the mix against proxy-model bits-per-byte ( Gao et al., 2021 , BPB,) metric on the benchmark’s training split and report the target model’s accuracy on a held-out set: test for ARC, and validation for HellaSwag and PIQA, whose test labels are withheld.
We also optimize for BPB validation loss on the Common Pile ( Kandpal et al., 2025 , CPile,) data corpus to diversify the setup.

blocks.en: 5 Theoretical Analysis
blocks.zh: 5 理论分析

blocks.en:
We formalize the domain attribution view of data mixing from first principles in Appendix E and summarize these results here.
Starting from linear datamodels ( Ilyas et al., 2022 ) , we show that the expected outcome of a proxy run is linear in its domain mix, with coefficients that average sample-level attribution scores (Proposition 2 , Corollary 2 ).
Domain attribution thus interpolates between data attribution and a single-domain corpus, preserving the linear structure in between.
We further relate it to the Shapley and Banzhaf data values of cooperative game theory in Remark 1 .
blocks.zh:
我们正式确定从附录E的第一原则混合数据的领域归属观点,并在此总结这些结果。
从线性数据模型(Ilyas et al., 2022)开始,我们显示一个代理运行的预期结果在其域组合中是线性,其系数是平均样本级归属分数(Proposition 2 , Corollary 2 ).
因此域归属在数据归属和单一域体之间插入,在两者之间保持线性结构.
我们进一步将它与Remark 1中合作游戏理论的Shapley和Bangzhaf数据值联系起来.

blocks.en:
With a finite budget of proxy runs, estimating the domain attribution is a linear regression whose error is governed by the design 𝚷 \boldsymbol{\Pi} (Lemma 1 ).
Dirichlet sampling inflates this error as the concentration γ \gamma grows and keeps its mixes close to the prior (Theorem 1 ).
With many domains, Dirichlet mixes cannot stay far from the prior because sparse mixes at a small γ \gamma violate the per-domain caps and are rejected.
We therefore tune γ \gamma empirically to a near-prior range (Section 4.1 ), for which the expected error of Dirichlet sampling is theoretically several times the lowest error possible with equal caps (Appendix E.3 ).
This matches Figure 3 , where both samplers lead to reliable fits at 24 domains, but no surrogate fits the Dirichlet design well at 288 domains.
In theory, vertex sampling without caps trains each proxy model on a single domain and thus estimates every domain attribution independently and equally well, which no other design can improve on (Proposition 3 ).
In practice, the caps force every mix to spread over several domains and reveal less about each of them, but vertex sampling remains the best possible design in expectation for equal caps (Theorem 2 ).

Under these idealizations, Theorems 1 and 2 help explain why the linear fit of LinMix can be more reliable than one based on Dirichlet sampling.
Dirichlet mixes concentrate around the prior, while vertices carry as much evenly spread information as the caps allow.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en:
We demonstrate that an interpretable linear model suffices for data mixing under vertex sampling and validate it across language model pretraining benchmarks.
We further develop the theoretical foundations of LinMix and relate data mixing to the attribution literature.
While this paper contributes to the interpretability of data mixing, our results suggest that optimizing a vertex-sampled matrix with a nonlinear model could yield even better target model performance, which we leave for future work.
We discuss limitations of our work in Appendix F , most importantly the cost of training a proxy swarm and the single training run per target model.
blocks.zh:
我们证明,可解释的线性模型足以在顶点取样下混合数据,并验证其跨语言模型预先训练基准。
我们进一步发展LinMix的理论基础,并将数据混合与归属文献联系起来.
虽然本文有助于解释数据的混合,但我们的结果表明,优化一个非线性模型的顶点抽样矩阵,可以产生更好的目标模型性能,我们留待未来工作。
我们在附录F中讨论了我们工作的局限性,最重要的是培训一个替补组的费用,以及每个目标模式的单一培训。

blocks.en:
Sampling 𝚷 \boldsymbol{\Pi} is a classic problem in statistics.
Because each row is a vector of domain proportions that sum to one, the proxy swarm is a mixture experiment ( Scheffé, 1958 ) .
Choosing inputs that minimize the variance of a regression estimate is the subject of optimal experimental design.
A design is D-optimal when it maximizes det ( 𝚷 ⊤ ​ 𝚷 ) \det(\boldsymbol{\Pi}^{\top}\boldsymbol{\Pi}) , which minimizes the volume of the confidence ellipsoid of 𝜷 ^ \hat{\boldsymbol{\beta}} ( Kiefer and Wolfowitz, 1959 ) .
For approximate designs, Kiefer and Wolfowitz (1960) show that maximizing this determinant also minimizes the worst-case prediction variance.
The D-optimal design for the first-degree mixture model places equal weight on the vertices of the simplex ( Kiefer, 1961 ) .
When upper bounds such as our caps u k u_{k} truncate the simplex, the extreme vertices designs of McLean and Anderson (1966) likewise use the vertices of the constrained region. LinMix follows this principle at a scale where computing exact optimal designs on 𝒫 cap \mathcal{P}_{\text{cap}} is impractical, sampling vertices generated by uniformly random domain permutations.
We prove that this sampling scheme is optimal in expectation on 𝒫 cap \mathcal{P}_{\text{cap}} with equal caps (Theorem 2 ) and leave the case of unequal caps to future work.
In Section 4.1 , we tune Dirichlet sampling by minimizing the condition number of 𝚷 \boldsymbol{\Pi} , a criterion closely related to D-optimality and det ( 𝚷 ⊤ ​ 𝚷 ) \det(\boldsymbol{\Pi}^{\top}\boldsymbol{\Pi}) .
Both degrade together because nearly-collinear mixes reduce the smallest singular value of 𝚷 \boldsymbol{\Pi} , thereby collapsing the determinant and inflating the condition number. LinMix also samples proxy mixes in pairs by filling domains in a random order and then in reverse order, following the idea of antithetic variates ( Hammersley and Morton, 1956 ) .
This relates to pairing sampled coalitions with their complements that has improved Shapley value approximation ( Fumagalli et al., 2026 ) , though our capped mixes need not be exact complements.
More broadly, regression design is of interest for improving attribution, e.g. Musco and Witter (2025) improve regression-based Shapley value approximation via leverage-score sampling of coalitions.

Data mixing methods differ in how they estimate domain value and spend compute to choose a mix ( Liu et al., 2026 ) .
Online methods adapt the mixture during training.
DoReMi ( Xie et al., 2023 ) learns weights during proxy training through group distributionally robust optimization, DoGE ( Fan et al., 2024 ) and Tan et al. (2026) use gradient-based updates guided by generalization or validation performance, and PiKE ( Li et al., 2025 ) re-weights data sources from their gradients.
MixMin ( Thudi et al., 2025 ) optimizes a weighted ensemble of proxy predictions, while Chameleon ( Xie et al., 2025 ) derives weights from relationships between domain embeddings.
Data Mixing Laws ( Ye et al., 2025 ) , AutoScale ( Kang et al., 2025 ) , and Shukor et al. (2025) use scaling relationships to predict mixture performance or select mixtures at larger training scales.
Mixture optimization also extends to tokenizers ( Won et al., 2026 ) and multimodal midtraining ( Wen et al., 2026 ) .
Adaptive search allocates new proxy runs to promising mixtures through iterative predictor fitting ( Diao et al., 2025 ) or Bayesian optimization ( Chen et al., 2025a ; Yen et al., 2025 ) . LinMix instead fixes its proxy mixtures before observing their outcomes, using vertex sampling to estimate domain effects across the feasible region.
This design enables a useful linear fit across hundreds of domains; combining it with adaptive search is a direction for future work.

blocks.en:
Regression-based data mixing methods select the target mix by minimizing a fitted surrogate model, offering little theoretical insight into the optimal mix itself ( Liu et al., 2025 ; Wettig et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2026 ) .
Recently, Chen et al. (2026) bound the performance loss when a previously optimized mix is reused after the domain set changes, taking the mixing law and its exact minimization as given. Thrush et al. (2025) rank domains by correlating the per-domain losses of public models with their benchmark scores instead, and prove that such rankings are optimally used by saturating the caps in rank order.
In our framework, this rule is the vertex solution of Eq. ( 5 ) at r = 0 r=0 , with the ranking estimated from a designed experiment on training mixtures rather than a correlation across uncontrolled models.
For r > 0 r>0 , the objective is a weighted isoelastic utility, also known as the alpha-fair family of resource allocation ( Mo and Walrand, 2000 ) , whose marginal utility grows unbounded at zero weight, so the maximizer places positive weight on every positively attributed domain (Proposition 1 ).
Corollary 1 solves the KKT conditions in closed form, yielding a capped water-filling allocation ( Boyd and Vandenberghe, 2004 , cf.) .

最近,Chen等人(2026年)在域位设定更改后重新使用之前优化的组合时,将性能损失绑定,按给定的混合定律及其精确最小化. 特鲁什等. (2025年)通过将公共模型的每个域损耗与其基准分数挂钩来排序域,并证明此类排名通过按等级顺序饱和上限来优化使用.
在我们的框架内,这一规则是Eq. (5) 的顶点溶液,在r = 0 r = 0时,根据一个设计出来的关于训练混合物的实验,而不是在不受控制的模型之间的相关性来估计排名。
对于r > 0 r>0,目标是加权异构的效用,又称资源分配的α-公平家族(Mo and Walrand, 2000 ),其边际效用在零重量下无约束增长,因此最大化者对每个正归属域(Proposition 1 )给予正重.

blocks.en:
Our work relates to the parallel literature on data attribution, which typically studies the influence of individual training examples rather than entire domains ( Ghorbani and Zou, 2019 ; Feldman and Zhang, 2020 ; Wang and Jia, 2023 ; Li and Yu, 2023 ) .
We identify a connection between regression-based data mixing and datamodels ( Ilyas et al., 2022 ; Saunshi et al., 2023 ) , which predict model outputs from training-set membership and show that a linear model can capture these dependencies.
DsDm ( Engstrom et al., 2024 ) turns this predictive view into data selection, using gradient-based TRAK estimates ( Park et al., 2023 ) to rank individual examples and select a fixed-size subset. LinMix shares this principle but estimates domain proportions from proxy runs and allocates tokens under domain caps.
Using these estimates for a larger target model requires that data effects transfer across scales, as studied by Khaddaj et al. (2025) .
Transfer depends on proxy training hyperparameters, as lower learning rates improve agreement with the dataset rankings of larger models ( Wang et al., 2026a ) .
With a limited number of runs ( Wang et al., 2025 ) , the question becomes which mixtures reveal enough about each domain to support the allocation, which vertex sampling answers by design.

DsDm (Engstrom et al., 2024) 将这种预测视图转化为数据选择,使用基于梯度的TRAK估计(Park et al., 2023)对单个实例进行排序,并选择一个固定大小的子集. LinMix 认同这一原则,但从代理运行中估计域比例,并在域上限下分配符号.
如Khaddaj等人(2025年)所研究的,使用这些估计数来建立一个更大的目标模型需要数据效应跨尺度转移。

blocks.en:
Data quality and filtering methods improve training corpora by selecting or weighting individual examples.
DataComp ( Gadre et al., 2023 ; Li et al., 2024 ) benchmarks how data curation affects large model performance.
Methods that combine selection criteria include Meta-rater ( Zhuang et al., 2025 ) , which learns combinations of quality scores from proxy runs, and Fan et al. (2026) , who jointly optimize quality and diversity through learned selection masks, while Group-MATES ( Yu et al., 2025b ) further accounts for interactions between examples.
During training, selection can adapt by coordinating multiple criteria ( Bai et al., 2025 ) , updating example weights ( Yu et al., 2025a ) , or scoring examples by their optimizer updates ( Wang et al., 2026b ) .
For fine-tuning, Ling et al. (2025) select data using a diversity reward, while LimaCost ( Moon et al., 2025 ) measures instruction-data value against a reference dataset using gradients.
Filtering and mixing can be combined by curating the corpus before optimizing its domain mix, as in our experiments.

blocks.en:
We tokenize data into single-domain sequences of 2048 tokens with the GPT-NeoX-20B tokenizer ( Black et al., 2022 ) , which has a vocabulary of 50,277 tokens.

blocks.en:
We formalize the domain attribution view of data mixing from first principles.
Starting from linear datamodels, we show that the expected outcome of a proxy run is linear in its domain mix, with coefficients that average sample-level attribution scores (Proposition 2 , Corollary 2 ), and that estimating them is a linear regression whose error is governed by the design 𝚷 \boldsymbol{\Pi} (Lemma 1 ).
Dirichlet sampling inflates this error as the concentration γ \gamma grows and keeps its mixes close to the prior, and also as the number of domains grows when the prior is more skewed than the temperature τ \tau can flatten (Theorem 1 ).
Vertex sampling is instead optimal on the simplex (Proposition 3 ) and, in expectation, on the simplex with equal caps (Theorem 2 ).

blocks.en: Appendix F Limitations
blocks.zh: 附录F 限制

blocks.en:
A limitation shared by all regression-based methods is the cost of training a proxy swarm, which we quantify here by scaling proxy model size and budget.
In practice, the cost-to-performance trade-off of data mixing becomes only more favorable as the target model size and pretraining budget increase.
For example, pretraining a 4B model on 120B tokens for 2.5k GPU hours could be designed with a swarm of 512 × 512\times 30M models computed for 0.1k GPU hours (4% of the target cost; cf. Appendix G ).
Naturally, we train the target models using a single random repetition to enable more experimental setups.
Our theory bounds the error of the estimated attribution 𝜷 ^ \hat{\boldsymbol{\beta}} , not the error of the predictions made with it.
Moreover, the noise level v max v_{\max} in our bounds depends on how the corpus is split into domains, so the d 2 / m d^{2}/m rate alone cannot tell how many domains to use.
Finally, whether the optimal mix is dense in positively attributed domains depends on the target benchmark, corpus size, and pretraining token budget.
We thus view the curvature r r that controls this as a useful utility trade-off, while the hyperparameter-free property of LinMix applies to the design of proxy-mix sampling and regression model fitting.

在实践中,随着目标模型规模和预先培训预算的增加,数据混合的成本与绩效的权衡变得更加有利。
例如,在 120B 令牌上预训 4B 型号 2.5k GPU小时可以设计为512×512\times 30M型,计算时间为0.1k GPU小时(目标成本的4%;参见附录G.).

blocks.zh: 附录G 计算资源

blocks.en:
All models are trained on NVIDIA GH200 96GB GPUs without special optimizations beyond the default code implementations.
Training one OLMo2 proxy model takes 0.2 GPU-hours for 30M parameters (1B tokens), 0.7 for 60M (2B), and 1.7 for 100M (3.2B).
The Qwen3.5-like 100M proxy takes 2.6 GPU-hours on the same 3.2B tokens, 1.5 times as much as OLMo2, which we attribute to its hybrid attention with gated DeltaNet layers that add constant overhead independent of model size.
Model evaluation adds further cost per proxy, depending on the benchmark and its sample size.
The proxy swarms cost 0.7k GPU-hours at 30M (1024 models at 24 domains and 2048 at 288 domains), 1.4k at 60M (2048 models), 1.8k at 100M for OLMo2 (1024 models), and 2.7k at 100M for Qwen3.5 (1024 models).
Pretraining a single 1B target model for 32B tokens takes 233 GPU-hours using 16 GPUs, so the 23 runs behind Table 1 and the 7 runs behind Tables 6 and 6 amount to ca. 7.0k.
The 1B Qwen3.5-like target model takes 272 GPU-hours on the same 32B tokens, so the four runs behind the CPile column of Table 2 amount to ca. 1.1k.
One 4B target run (80B tokens) takes 1.7k GPU-hours using 32 GPUs, so the 10 runs behind Table 2 amount to ca. 17k.
Together with model evaluations, the reported experiments cost ca. 34k GPU-hours; we estimate that the whole project consumed ca. 51k GPU-hours, including preliminary work and failed jobs.
